captions.detailed: A vintage-style camera prime lens assembly finished in matte black. It features a wide, ribbed focus ring at the base, a mid-barrel section, and a telescoping front barrel housing a glass element at the top. The focus ring rotates continuously around the central optical axis, while the front barrel moves linearly along the same axis to simulate helicoid extension.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a vintage screw-mount camera prime lens. It should feature a base mount, a ribbed focus ring that rotates about the optical axis, and an extending front barrel with a glass lens element that translates prismatically along the optical axis.
captions.factory: The code constructs a camera lens using three main parts: a base, a focus ring, and a front barrel. The base is created with a cylinder and a bottom screw mount. The focus ring is built by subtracting rectangular keyways from a cylindrical ring to create a ribbed grip texture. The front barrel consists of a tapered cylinder housing a flat glass disc. A continuous joint connects the focus ring to the base, and a prismatic joint allows the front barrel to slide linearly relative to the base.
